items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: We saw him. We spent a lot of time with him.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear of a guy whose name is Manuel Mineta? Manuel Mineta, sure. Do you know him?

Oh, yeah. Manuel Mineta played violin and piano. Played trumpet. He's teaching now. We saw him. We spent a lot of time with him. He's teaching music now. He's a little over in Algiers. That's right. I don't know Manuel. Call him horse.
A lot of people still call him horse.
